blocks.text: Heart of Harmony Homes - 3, 3.5 & 4 BHK Residence Features
137 Exclusive Homes A Community of Like-Minded Neighbours
With only a select number of residences in the development, Heart of Harmony creates a close-knit environment where neighbors share an aspiration for quality living.
At Heart of Harmony, 137 exclusive 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK and 4 BHK residences house a close-knit community of families who chose privacy, quality, and a shared aspiration for premium living.
Fewer homes per floor allow greater privacy, quieter surroundings, and a more relaxed residential experience.
Heart of Harmony Floor Plans — 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK & 4 BHK Configurations

Heart of Harmony offers 137 exclusive 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK and 4 BHK sky residences at Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru. Every floor plan is designed for maximum space, privacy and 270° panoramic views. Possession: March 2030. RERA: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560.”

items.q: What floor plans are available at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Heart of Harmony offers 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK and 4 BHK sky residence floor plans. The 3 BHK is available in Classic, Premium and Luxe variants. The 3.5 BHK includes a dedicated study or flex room. The 4 BHK Grande is the most spacious configuration. All homes feature zero common walls and 270-degree panoramic views.

items.a: Pricing for 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK and 4 BHK residences at Heart of Harmony is available on request. Contact the CKPC Properties team at +91 76499 99586 or enquire online for the latest pricing and payment plan details

items.q: What is the carpet area of 3 BHK homes at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Carpet area details for 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK and 4 BHK homes at Heart of Harmony are available on request. Contact the sales team at +91 76499 99586 or download the brochure for detailed floor plan specifications.

items.q: When is the possession of Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Heart of Harmony possession is scheduled for March 2030 as per RERA registration number PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560. All construction milestones are verifiable on the RERA Karnataka portal at rera.karnataka.gov.in.

items.q: How many BHK options are available at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Heart of Harmony offers 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK and 4 BHK sky residences — 137 exclusive homes in a 24-storey tower with only 6 residences per floor and zero common walls between apartments.
